commands.command: /bin/zsh -lc "cat AGENTS.md docs/index.md docs/completion.md docs/export-notes.md; git diff -- tasklist/cli.py tasklist/tasks.py tests/test_tasks.py; git diff --cached; rg --files --hidden -g '"'!.git/**'"'"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import ast
import re
from pathlib import Path

page = Path('docs/completion.md')
for label, target in re.findall(r'\\[(["'^'"\\]]+)\\]\\((["'^)]+)'"\\)', page.read_text()):
    path = page.parent / target
    assert path.is_file(), (label, target)
    if path.suffix == '.py':
        names = {node.name for node in ast.walk(ast.parse(path.read_text())) if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.ClassDef))}
        symbol = 'main' if label == '"'`main` function in the CLI'"' else label
        assert symbol in names, (symbol, path)
assert '[completion](completion.md)' in Path('docs/index.md').read_text()
print('Completion page links, referenced Python symbols, and incoming index link verified.')
PY"
/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check; git diff -- docs/completion.md; git status --short'
